name: Flying Crane Technique — "They gain" resolves to the group the previous sentence untapped
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (42-card cluster 'they gain KEYWORD until end of turn'). 'Untap all creatures you control. They gain flying and double strike until end of turn.' produced no effect: no parser understood the pronoun. _resolveTheyPronoun (cards-text-utils.js) now rewrites a sentence-initial 'They gain/get/have/become' to the 'all …' / 'each …' / '… target …' group named in the preceding sentence before the generic parsers run. It deliberately leaves 'They' alone after a sentence that creates tokens or puts cards onto the battlefield.
